spec: pocket SPEC v5, task F3 (Seixo, variant B)
frame: SPEC: x right from the case's leftmost point, y towards the player, mm (= KiCad top view)

mounting_holes.note: M2 from below through the bottom plate's pillar, nut on top of the board
M2 from below through the bottom plate's pillar, nut on top of the board

levels_note: h = height above the board's top face; each polygon is free room at that height (the case, its fixed parts, the speaker box, the battery bay, the panel and controls boards taken out)

stack.kind: LOW (PECAS stack.low): Teensy soldered straight on the Audio Board with long headers
stack.usb_end: left (x small): the Teensy's micro-B faces the left wall

usb_plug.note: 90 deg micro-B overmould 11 x 11 x 7.5 (PECAS micro_b_link); its cable goes up/back to the panel board

controls.tabs_note: the EC11E's two tabs (E2b): the back one over the Audio Board, the front one in a dent of the speaker box's back wall (x 26.5-35.7, y <= 58.0, z <= 18.5, open below to the box floor at z 12.10)
controls.encoder_rot: as the eTuttino (A/B/C to the back)

connector.note: 10-way SH header on top, 12 along y, cable leaves +x then drops in cables.controls

lid_recess.note: SPEC v5: the M7 nut sits flush in it (no anti-rotation hole: clip the pot's pin; the soldered boards stop it turning)

pot.note: horizontal-type 9 mm switched pot on a VERTICAL board right of the shaft (x 21.62-23.22), its body to the left, M7 bushing nutted flush in a D13 recess of the lid; the pot board meets the controls board's left edge at 90 deg

panel.note: SPEC v5: no panel board. The micro-B extension is an FPC ribbon (PECAS micro_b_panel_cable): its female head sits in a tunnel of a block on the back-left wall's flat chord boss (a 0.5 lip at the wall, a printed bar 'trava' with 2 x M2 x 5 behind it); the 'UP' male's ribbon rises from the Teensy plug's top, folds flat under the block (2.0 room) and goes up to the trava's slot; the spare (10 cm cable) lies folded flat over the Teensy. The jack (Cliff FC681375V) is on its own facet, axis +x, nut outside. Nothing of this touches the main board.

jack.note: turned: 9.0 across (y), 10.5 tall; bottom at z 18.70 over J_BAT (top 18.2); wires (4) from the back tabs to J_JACK

vusb_wire.note: 26 AWG from the Teensy's VUSB pad out of the stack's USB end, over the Audio Board's left edge, to J_VBUS

battery.board_notch: the outline leaves out x < 70.95, y > 48.35 and, for the connector pocket, x < 27.70, y > 39.10

connector_pocket.note: the battery's PHR-3 mates here with the pigtail's in-line male, lying flat, axis along x (PECAS connector_pocket_v4 >= 14.5 x 9.0 x 6.0); open to the cradle along its front for the battery's wires; pull the battery out of the hatch and unplug, without opening the lid

pigtail_way_in.note: through the pocket's back wall and roof, from J_BAT (or pads) in connector_zones.back_left

wire_hole.note: sealed with glue after threading the 2 wires

controls.note: the 10-way SH cable drops here from the controls board to J_CTL

cables.panel: FPC ribbon (10 cm) from the Teensy's 'UP' plug to the female on the wall (panel.ribbon); 4 jack wires to J_JACK; VBUS wire to J_VBUS
cables.battery: 3 wires (~60) from the bay's wire exit to J_BAT
cables.speaker: 2 wires (152) from the box's wire hole to J_SPK

back_left.note: left of the Teensy's plug, under the jack (bottom z 18.70) and the female's block (bottom z 23.85): PH plugs (10.5 tall) and wire pads fit; check the exact edge against levels['10.5']

J_CTL.note: SH-10 vertical (4.25 + plug) between the Audio Board's front edge and the battery notch
